en.summary: More developers are using coding agents to write code, run checks, and open PRs. As more development teams move toward the "software factory" model, approvals are becoming the next bottleneck. Routine fixes and dependency updates across multiple repositories can leave engineers facing a growing queue of PRs awaiting approval.

en.title: Yuanzi: Surrounded by AI assistants — attention is at the center of everything
en.summary: After building 18 AI assistants, Yuanzi found himself overwhelmed by a constant flood of messages and to-dos — until it hit him: AI can handle execution at near-zero cost, but it can't replace the human cost of being present. Attention is the core of human-AI collaboration. He also shared a directly reusable attention-protection playbook: tiered task archiving, distilled personal preference guidelines, and strict daily limits on high-focus hours.

en.summary: The author has open-sourced a WeChat Official Account drafting workbench built on DeepSeek Harness, pulling scattered AI capabilities into a single unified workspace. It supports targeted section-by-section revisions, AI content QC, custom IP covers, smart image selection and SVG animation generation, and one-stop layout — plus scheduling and data retrospectives, with learnings distilled into reusable Skills. Plugins let you swap skills and visual styles to match your own creative habits. Give it a try!

en.title: Gemini 4 Neon launches: element No. 10, neon
en.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Neon is officially live, with the Argon, Carbon, and Hydrogen models each handling their own role. Positioned as a central orchestrator for Agent swarms, it takes aim at Opus and Sol. It can dispatch sub-agents to work problems in concert, independently build complex 3D scenes and front-end projects, and beats competitors on multiple benchmarks. Developers can give it a try.

items_all.title: 大型企业和银行落地 AI 智能体，宁可推进慢半拍，也绝不交出私有数据与业务控制权。 今早在新加坡金融科技节（SFF 2026）上，华为推出面向银行的“双超级智能体”方案，核心直指企业从试点走向生产必须锁死自有知识与逻辑；同日新发的 Phai-A1 也把百万上下文塞进个人电脑，单卡编码快 8 到 10 倍。 落地启示：给企业做工作流交付，主打“本地轻量模型+私有数据不出内网”，签单最痛快。 #企业AI #本地大模型 #工作流优化
